___style_anchor: Handcrafted tactile stop-motion puppet photography — sculpted polymer clay elderly artisan character in profile with wavy fiber hair and rolled-sleeve workwear reaching toward a richly detailed miniature wooden apothecary cabinet.

visual_mood.primary_feeling: Focused artisanal dedication, nostalgic curiosity, and quiet craftsman intimacy
visual_mood.viewer_impression: An immediate sense of rich miniature world-building, exquisite stop-motion texture, and delicate physical storytelling
visual_mood.narrative_subtext: A passionate master toymaker or antique collector carefully browsing through his towering cabinet of handcrafted curiosities and miniature sculptures

medium.backdrop_medium: Physically fabricated miniature timber workshop set with multi-tiered apothecary shelves, carved drawers, and miniature ceramic pottery

Intricate hand-carved drawer panels with tiny brass pull knobs on the miniature apothecary unit.
Crisp circular metallic rivet button securing the terracotta suspender strap to the trousers.
Pinpoint white specular glint in the dark eye bead gazing intently at the shelf contents.

composition.canvas_zoning: Dual-zone composition: left 45% anchored by the character in profile; right 55% filled by the towering miniature wooden apothecary cabinet
composition.layer_stack_z_index: Layer 0: Dark blurred workshop background on far left -> Layer 1: Character torso and head -> Layer 2: Outstretched forearm and hand -> Layer 3: Foreground wooden cabinet shelves and miniature artifacts on right
composition.framing_crop: Medium profile shot cropped at the waist and mid-torso
composition.headroom_and_ground_clearance: Approx 8% headroom above white hair; lower frame clips below waistline
composition.frame_edge_clipping_and_bleed: Left elbow bleeds past left edge; right cabinet structure bleeds beyond top, right, and bottom edges
composition.ground_pedestal: Implied floor just below lower frame boundary

depth_of_field.sharp_zone: Tack-sharp plane on the character's facial profile, hair, outstretched arm, hand, and the front vertical shelf edge
depth_of_field.blurred_zone: Soft optical falloff to the background room on the far left and deep cabinet interiors
depth_of_field.blur_strength: Macro optical depth of field blur (approx f/2.8)

composition.rule_of_thirds: Character's head and eye align along the left third vertical axis; outstretched hand and active shelf align along the right third vertical axis

grid_and_accent_anchors.construction_grid: Strong horizontal motion line created by the reaching arm connecting the vertical left character to the vertical right cabinet

background.setting: Artisan craftsman workshop, toymaker atelier, or miniature curio study
background.key_elements: Massive multi-compartment dark wood apothecary cabinet with carved drawers, cubbies, miniature ceramics, figurines, and a soft out-of-focus background on the far left
background.layer_order: Far background room on left -> character in midground -> towering cabinet structure on right
background.background_density: High detail density on the right cabinet structure; clean soft blur on the left background
background.background_treatment: Dimensional physical set with soft directional lighting and optical depth of field falloff

negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, 3D CGI plastic render, glossy plastic skin, smooth flat digital vector, photorealistic human skin, young person, bright modern room, deformed hands, extra fingers, outer decorative border, ornate frame, picture frame
reconstruction_priority: Sculpted clay facial profile with hooked nose and expressive eye — AI often rounds out the face or creates generic cartoon facial anatomy.
Elongated muscular/tendinous forearm and reaching hand anatomy — AI tends to make arms too short or mangle miniature fingers.
Intricate miniature wooden cabinet with carved drawers and miniature pottery — AI often turns complex shelving into a blurry generic brown wall.
Wavy wool-felt hair sculpture with tactile fiber texture — AI tends to smooth hair into polygon ribbons.
